title: A Worker as every Orchestrator sees it, published by the Worker to the shared store; publishing is its heartbeat. Its commands and paths stay on its own machine.

name.description: Its name; Performer names are Worker names.

host.description: The machine it runs on, as the machine names itself.

cloud.description: Its work happens in the cloud.

programs.description: The programs it has a command for, by name. It offers every StepDefinition that names one of them.

capabilities.description: The words it offers to what a StepDefinition requires; opaque, compared for equality.

slots.description: How many orders it runs at once (default 1).

holds.description: The orders it holds a claim on.

beat_s.description: The longest it goes between publishing, in seconds (default 60); unheard for three beats, it is away and nothing new is placed on it.

time.description: RFC 3339, UTC, so that later sorts later.
